tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ bla ma rje btsun mus pa chen po dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rje btsun bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ /rje btsun mkha' spyod mchod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /rje btsun mus pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir du/ /rje btsun gong ma'i gsung bzhin 'dir bshad bya/ /rgyud sde kun gyi yang zab gsang mtha' yi/ /lam bzang kun gyi bcud bsdus rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sgrub dkyil kun gyi nang nas rab gsal 'di/ /'gro ba kun gyis nyams su len phyir spel/ /ngo mtshar dal 'byor lan gcig thob dus 'dir/ /ngo mtshar sa skya'i yab chos yang snying mchog /ngo mtshar 'di 'dra nyams len skal ba 'di/ /ngo mtshar las kyang mchog tu ngo mtshar lags/ /skal bzang kho bo'i rjes 'jug slob ma rnams/ /skal bzang lam 'dir spro bas rab zhugs la/ /skal bzang mang po 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod kyis/ /skal bzang grangs med mkha' spyod 'dren par mdzod/ /ces mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang spro ba bskyed pa'i tshig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga rang bzo'i skyon spangs nas/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab bzhin bkod pa la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la bsod nams gsog par 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang / sgrib pa sbyong bar 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcu ste/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis sogs dus khyad par can gyi tshe/

rang nyid kyi sgrub khang la sogs pa dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas byi dor byas par/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma chos skyong sogs kyi bris 'bur gyi sku yod na/ tshul bzhin du bshams la/ 'thas shing ngos snyoms pa'i sa gzhi'am/ maṇ+ḍal lam shing gi stegs bu la sogs pa gang yang rung ba la/ dri bzang gi chus byugs/ khru gang la sogs pa'i tshad kyi zlum skor bya/ de'i phyi rol tu sor phyed tsam bskyed pa'i zlum skor gnyis pa bya/ nang gi zlum skor dang mthun par chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab/ de la tshon dgye ba ni/ chos 'byung gnyis dmar po/ thig gi gcod mtshams re kha dkar po/ nang gi zlum skor dang chos 'byung gi bar gyi khyams rnams ljang khu/ mu khyud sngon po/ yang na khyams sngon po la mu khyud ljang khur bya ba'ang bshad pas gang bde bya'o/ /mu khyud kyi phyi nang gnyis ka'i re kha dkar po/ chos 'byung gnyis kyi dbus su tshon spungs dkar po dgu byas pa'i/ rtse mo rnams brdal ba'i dbus ma'i steng du tshon spungs dmar po byed/ gzhan brgyad po ni pad+ma'i 'dab ma mtshon byed du gsungs so/ /de ni sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin la/ 'di nyid 'jug pa bde bar 'dod pas ras sam dar dmar po sogs la bris pas kyang rung bar bshad cing / de'i steng du mañdzi la sogs pa'i khar/ rdo thod dam thod pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du chang la sbrang ngam bu ram la sogs pa sbyar/ bdud rtsi ril bu'i phye ma btab pa dpral ba rang nyid la phyogs par bzhag de'i steng dar dmar ram ras dmar pos kha bcad de/ de ni gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor yin zhing / de'i khar rin po che'am gang yang rung ba'i maṇ+ḍal zlum po gcig gi steng / dri ma med par byas pa gur gum mam chang gis byugs pa la/ sin+dhu ra'i phye ma gtsags pas khye ma med par bkram ste/ gser gyi thur ma'am/ med na rdo rje'i rtse mos chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su/

rgya yig gam/ bod yig gang yang rung bas bam̐ yig bris pa'i mthar mdun nas g.yon skor gyi oṃ gsum ma'i sngags mgo phyir bstan khor yug tu bri/ de yang oṃ gsum de'i rjes su/ sarba dang / bud+dha dang / ḍā ki dang / nī ye dang / badz+ra dang / war+ṇa dang / nī ye dang / badz+ra dang / bai ro dang / tsa nī ye dang / hūm̐ gsum dang / phaṭ gsum dang / swāhā rnams rim bzhin g.yon skor du bri ba ma gtogs 'bru re re nas bzlog pa mi mdzad cing / yi ge thams cad dbu can du bri/ 'di la'ang / shar drang por oṃ dang / byang du ḍā dang / nub tu war+ṇa dang / lhor nī bris na cha snyoms par 'gyur zhing / yang bla ma gong ma'i phyag len 'khrul med kyi chos 'byung bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa shing sogs la brkos nas par du btab chog pa yod tshe lag len bzhin btab la/ chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re re bri ste/ de ni thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin no/ /de rnams kyi steng du dar dmar lā dmar ram ras dmar gang yang rung ba'i gur khang legs par phub/ de'i mtha' skor byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog gzhan chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga g.yon skor du bshams/ gzhan yang gong gi bris 'bur gyi sku'i drung du/ gtor ma dam rdzas lnga'am/ bdun nam/ bcu gcig gam/ gcig la sogs pa dang / bskang gtor sogs rang rang gi phyag len bzhin bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs par bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad nas 'bras sogs 'bru gang 'byor gyi tshom bu brgyad la/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig mgul chings dmar pos dkris/ kha nas gu gul gyis bdug sum+bha ni bzlas shing zhabs nas yungs kar gyis brab la bzhag kha rgyan ku sha gtsang ma/ dung chos/ rdo rje gzungs thag bum nang du chu gtsang ma la dri bzang dang / bdud rtsi ril bu sogs bla med nas gsungs pa'i bum rdzas mtshan nyid ldan pa sbyar/

bum rdzas tshang ma ye ma 'byor na nang mchod nas ji ltar rigs pa dang dri bzang bsres pas rung / gzhan yang rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba/ maṇ+ḍal chung ngu me tog nas dang bcas pa dang / sgrub grogs rnams kyi mdun du'ang rdor dril ḍā ma ru nang mchod dung chos rnams dang / rnga cha lang dung la sogs pa/ dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa 'du bya ba ni sbyor ba'i chos so/ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod de/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba ni/ mchod g.yog pas sngon 'gro gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs nas/ phyag gsum btsal la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyi rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a na ya hoḥbha ga wan bid+yā+e ra dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥlan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor zhing / phaiṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwam̐/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣe rak+ṣa sa bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+mā da/ a pasma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā/ da ya/ i dam+ba liṃ/ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai wm/ ya theṣ+ṭam̐/ bhuñdza tha dzi gh+ra tha pi ba tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kār+ya/ sat+su kham̐/ bi shud+dha/ sa hā ya ka bha ban+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swa hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+gham̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing srin lag gis nang mchod kyang dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/

lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad kun/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' bstod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun spyod cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/

sa'i phyogs 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung zhing / dngos grub sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ mchod g.yog pas gtor ma phyi rol tu dor ro/ /de nas gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal te/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu zhes pa dang / dpon slob rnams kyi rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ ar+gham̐/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/

rol chen dang / oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ sam̐ pra ra ṇi ta/ sar+b+ba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi tā/ nā da swa bhā wa na/ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a kham̐ swāhā/ tshar gsum gyi dang pos mchod yul spyan drangs/ gnyis pas mchod yul de rnams kyis gnas khang byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas mchod rdzas la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /de nas zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bde kye ltar byas la/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam pa la/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i rgyab khaṇ+ḍa ro ha'i mdun du chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu ste/ de yang gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ chos po ti'i rnam pa ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod pas skyabs yul gsal btab/ 'di ni skyabs yul gyi dmigs pa rgyas pa'i lugs te/ bsdus pa ltar na/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bla ma dkon mchog gi 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam pa'am/ yang na bla ma dkon mchog dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngo bo rnam pa dpa' bo rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi skur bsgom pa yang bshad do/ /de nas skyabs 'gro dngos ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag

rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ nyi shu rtsa gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gtso bo bla ma 'od sngon por zhu/ rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ chos po ti 'od dmar por zhu/ mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'khor gyi lha rnams 'od dkar por zhu/ dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas tshad med kyi ngo bo sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /tshar gsum/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan zhing zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab kyi sku gang / rdo rje'i lam brgyud yum gyi pad+mar babs yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis ka'i sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang / rkang mthil gnyis nas thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā lā ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sidhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba kar+m+ma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shrī yam̐ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ badz+ra he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ de nas/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gnas pa de nyid gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod de gsal gdab pa ni sku'i dga' ba yin la/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nang mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ

lan gsum bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying gar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin bam̐ yig ma la ste/ de la bdud rtsi phul bas zag med kyi bde bas thugs rgyud tshim par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi myang ngo / /de yang snying gar bam̐ yig bsgom pa thugs kyi dga' ba/ bdud rtsi myang ba gsung gi dga' ba yin par gsungs so/ /de nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dpa' bo rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas bde stong gi sgra sgrog pa'i ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ gru mor kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin zhing / rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ de nyid la blo kha zhe med par gtad de/ bdag skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / re sa dang ltos sa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che khyed rang mkhyen snyam pa'i dad gus dung dung pa dang bcas thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum zhe thag pa nas gsol ba btab ste bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags la/ de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis bla ma de nyid 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres te bde stong gi rang bzhin du gyur/

ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon skor gyi/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa las/ 'od zer 'phros rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang nyid rnam snang rigs bdag dang bcas pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la ḍā ma ru dang / dril bu dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing bsgom pa ni bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'o/ /de nas 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros/

phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gzhal yas khang dang / nang bcud kyi sems can la phog pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa ste ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon du bskor zhing / phaiṃ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / 'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas lag pa gnyis pad skor dang 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dha3ham̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas go cha dgod pa ni/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ go cha bkod pa 'di ye shes pa gzhug pa'i snga rting gang la bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med de/ sngon la bsgom pa rgyud gzhung phal cher gyi dgongs pa yin zhing / rting la bsgom pa jo bo nā ro ta pa'i man ngag yin par gsungs pas/ 'dir ni de nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin no/ /de ltar go cha bkod pa'i rjes su bskyed rim la sems 'dzin gyi dmigs pa bsdus tsam zhig bsgom la/ de nas bzlas pa la gnyis kyi/ dang po ngag bzlas bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/

tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams sbyangs/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ de dag gi sna las phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa sprul te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la phul bas/ thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can gyis brnyes pas/ rang gi tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag yang 'od zer de sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par nam mkha' gang bar byon nas/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lnga brgya dang stong la sogs pa'am/ tha na yang brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i dam bca' las mi nyung ba bzla ba gal che ste/ spyir gsang sngags thams cad kyi zab mo'i mthar thug pa ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor 'di rnams yin par gsungs shing / de'i yang yang zab mthar thug pa ni rje btsun lū nag dril gsum gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim rnams yin la/ de dag gi don gyi snying po ma lus pa 'dus pa'i man ngag gi yang rtser gyur pa ni nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam 'di nyid yin par gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang bsgrub bya'i yul du gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang / de rnams bye ba phyed dang bzhi ru 'dus pa yin la/

de yang stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'dus shing / de yang sum cu rtsa bdun du 'dus/ de yang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am brgyad dam lngar 'dus/ de yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di kho na la 'dus pas/ 'di nyid gcig pu sgom zhing bsgrubs pas/ mkha' 'gro ma bye ba rab 'byams ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa bsgoms pa dang bsgrubs par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du 'di'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma la yang / sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi ngo bo 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags thams cad 'dus par bshad pas/ de la dgongs nas bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bde mchog lū nag gi byin rlabs drug skor gyi skabs dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha thams cad kyi bzlas sngags la yum gyi nye snying kho na bzlas chog par gsungs pa yin la/ des na gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma 'di la chig bsgril du byas pas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs 'khul zhing byin gyis rlob par 'gyur zhing / oṃ gsum ma lan gcig tsam brjod pas kyang bskal pa mang po'i sgrib pa 'dag par nges pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan gsang sngags pa rnams tshe gcig lus gcig la dngos grub thob pa'i gnad kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi zab gnad dang ldan pa las byung ba yin par gsungs pa sogs rtsod pa dang bral ba'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab dang gsung rgyun dag las/ spyir mi lus lan gcig tsam thob pa'i dus 'dir gsang sngags zab mo'i lam nyams su len pa shin tu skal ba bzang ba'i tshul dang / lhag par mkha' spyod dbang mo 'di nyid kyi bzlas sgom nyams su blangs pa phan yon gzhan las ches che ba'i rgyu mtshan sgrub byed mang du 'byung yang 'dir ni ma spros la/ shes par 'dod na kho bo'i ngag las 'tshol bar bya'o/ /de nas yid bzlas bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa lte bar babs te de'i chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba rnams la sems gtad/

ces brjod cing bsam la rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ de nas 'og rlung bskum/ steng rlung mnan te kha sbyar bum pa can bzung la/ gong du gsal btab pa'i dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams la sems gtad pa'i ngang nas yid kyi bam̐ yig gi tha ma'i sngags phreng g.yon skor du klog tshul byed cing phreng ba la grangs bzung / rlung ci thub kyi bar la oṃ gsum ma bzla/ mi thub pa dang rlung dal bus sgo nas glod/ yid bzlas 'di ni rdzogs rim mtshan bcas yin pas drod bde ba skye zhing / 'phar g.yo drag tu 'byung la/ de byung na ril gyis glod/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags thams cad kyang 'di nyid las 'byung bar bshad do/ /de nas yid bzlas kyi rlung dal bus btang grub pa dang bzlas pa bsdu ba ni phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing phreng ba mgo thog tu bzhag de nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste de yang gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas lus kyi bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas lus kyi smad kyi cha la thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba chos 'byung nyis brtsegs la thim/ de zla ba la thim/ de sngags 'phreng la thim/ de bam̐ yig la thim/ bam̐ yig khog pa mgo bo la thim/ de zla tshes la thim/ de thig le la thim/ de nā da la thim/ de yang je phra je phrar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/

ces brjod cing don bsam la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de nas rtog pa 'phro na/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces brjod pas go cha dgod pa gsal gdab la/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nang mchod dang mañdzi steng gi gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor byin rlabs rgyas par bya ba ni/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su go las ba glang gi sha shar du ku las khyi'i sha byang du da las glang po che'i sha nub tu ha las rta'i sha lhor na las mi'i sha de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su chos dbyings ye shes/ shar du bh+rum̐༞ me long lta bu'i༞ byang du kham̐༞ bya ba grub pa'i༞ nub tu dz+rīṃ༞ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ lhor oṃ las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar zhing / rdzas rnams zhu zhing skol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par byung nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim pas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi la thim/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gsum char la gtor la/ sum+bha ni/ sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu mda'i dra ba dang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon bskor gyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la ḍā ma ru dang / dril bu dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa bskyed/ de nas ye shes pa bstims shing go cha dgod pa dang / dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa rnams ni/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ de nas 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba d+dharmā yo ga shud+dha3ham̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas go cha dgod pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i gnas su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha tsiṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/

slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swabha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+gham̐/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi steng gi cha la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis bskor ba dang bcas pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa tsam gyis sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar bzhugs par bsam la/ de rnams dang mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la mchod pa'i bsam pas/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas so so thogs pa mang du sprul nas/ mchod yul thams cad la mchod pa phul bas mnyes par bsam la/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/

/lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra ar+gham̐ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sar+b+ba sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas me tog ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta/ sogs dang / badz+ra puṣ+pe zhes pas me tog dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas bdug spos ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sar+b+ba sogs dang / badz+ra ā lo ke zhes pas mar me dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas dri mchog ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sar+b+ba sogs dang / badz+ra gan+dhaṃ zhes pas dri chab dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas zhal zas ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sar+b+ba sogs nas/ badz+ra nai bi d+yaṃ zhes pa zhal zas dang / stong gsum༞ lha rdzas rol mo ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sar+b+ba sogs nas badz+ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas rol mo ste/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi'i rol chen dang bcas pa rnams rang rang gi sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis 'bul ba ste phyi mchod do/ /na bza'i mchod pa ni/ rten kheb la sogs pa'i gos bzung la/ rdo rje rtses bdud rtsi gtor/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa/ 'jam pa/ yang ba/ lha re re la bzung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ srab 'jam yangs pa lha yi gos/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni/

sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra baṣ+ṭa ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la lha re re la stod g.yogs smad g.yogs phul bar bsam/ rig ma bcu drug mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams sku mdog rgyan cha lugs so so'i mchod rdzas rnams thogs pa spros te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchod par bsam la/ spro ba'i sngags dngos ni/ oṃ bī ni badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ zhes brjod/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi waṃ ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs pi waṃ sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra bī 'di la sgra snyan bsgyur tshul gyi phyag rgya byed/ ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la mchod par bsam/ de bzhin du/ oṃ waṃ s+ya badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ gser bzang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gling bu'i sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / waṃ s+ya badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mṛ tam̐ ga badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rdza rnga ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / mṛ 'di la rnga sbo logs nas brdungs tshul byed/ taṃ ga badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ murdzi badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnga zlum sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / murdzi 'di la rnga steng nas rdung tshul byed/ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ha s+ya badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / ha s+ya badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/

oṃ la s+ya badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg mo ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga tā sogs dang / la s+ya badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ girti badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs snyan pa'i glu yis mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / girti badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ nirti badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ pri yang ku mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / nirti badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puṣ+paṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs me tog sil mas mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / puṣ+paṃ badz+ri ni pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhū paṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ in+d+ra nī la'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdug pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / dhū paṃ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dī paṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mar me'i phreng bas mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / dī paṃ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gan+dhaṃ badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ sin+dhū mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dri bzang byug pas mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / gan+dhaṃ badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ru pa badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gzugs kyi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang /

ru pa badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ra sa badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ btsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ro yi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / ra sa badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ par+ṣ+ya badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs reg bya'i bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba 'di la gos bzung lag pas blang la 'bul tshul byed/ ta thā ga ta sogs dang / par+ṣ+ya badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dharmā dhā tu badz+ri ni hūm̐ ā/ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ nam mkha'༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos khams bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / dharmā dhā 'di la nor bu mig gsum pa'i phyag rgya byed/ tu badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dbul te rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'o/ /rin chen bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las rin po che sna bdun rim pa bzhin du byung nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod par bsam ste/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra tsakra rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa༞ nor bu rin chen༞ bkren cing phongs pa༞ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / ma ṇi rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad nas/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / bāsti rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/

/phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / ma hasta rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal te/ /bla med theg pa rab bgrod nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / hasti rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol nas/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / tu raṅga a shwa rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /snyan grags mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / khat+ga rat+na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas 'bul ba ste/ rin chen sna bdun gyi mchod pa'o/ /'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ mchod pa ji snyed yod pa rnams bsdu na dngos su bshams pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa'i gzugs la sogs pa/ mchod pa'i khyad par rnams kyis mchod par mos te/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ongs rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla ma'i grub mchog stsal du gsol/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / ru pa kā ma gu ṇ+ya badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshim byed sgra snyan yid 'ongs ldan/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / shap+da kā ma gu ṇ+ya badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas tsan+dan sbrul snying dang / /a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang /

gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇ+ya badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / ra sa kā ma gu ṇ+ya badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas 'jam nyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed pa/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs dang / par+ṣe kā ma gu ṇ+ya badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas 'dod yon lngas mchod nas/ de nas nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod la 'bru gsum brjod cing g.yon du lan gsum chos 'byung 'bri tshul gyis bskor la dbus nas blangs te gtor bas/ rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur pas mchod par bsam la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rje btsun mus chen sangs rgyas rang rang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs gang las thob pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod pa'o/ /rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas thog mar rtsa ba'i bla mar phul nas/ de'i rjes su brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la nang mchod 'bul ni/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /grub pa'i sar bzhugs paṇa chen na ro pa/ /pham gcen 'jigs med grags pa mthing sku mched gcung dus 'khor ba zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /zab yang chos kyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos bla chen sa skya pa/ /rje btsun sku mched zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

/gnas lnga rig pa sa skya paṇa chen dang / /'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /rim gnyis thugs gzhol dkon mchog dpal ba dang / /brag phug chos rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /gdams pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan pa/ /shar chen ye rgyal ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / /kun dga' bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / /kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po seng ge'i mtshan/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas rin chen dang / /sa skya lo tsā'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /shes bya kun mkhyen dkon mchog lhun grub dang / /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /gang gi thugs sras bsod nams dbang po dang / /grags pa blo gros zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /bla ma lhar gzigs sangs rgyas dpal bzang dang / /mkhas grub chen po dpal ldan rgyal po'i zhabs/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter gyur bzang po dpal/ /paṇa chen nam dbang zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /grub chen sbas pa'i sangs rgyas chos dbang phyug /de sras dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /'khor lo sdom pa ngur smrig bla gos can/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan kho bos spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan dang / grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan las kyang 'di'i chos skor thob mod kyang / gcig chog rgyal po rgyal ba mus pa chen po dang dbyer med du byas nas nang mchod 'bul ba'i lugs su byas te/ brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba'i bla ma mang po'i mtshan rnams 'dzin 'don gnyis ka la dka' bar bsam nas 'dir ma bris so/ /zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang / chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams spyi gtsug tu thig le byas/ phung khams skye mched lha'i ngo bor gsal ba bde bas tshim par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ dharmā pa la tsa turmu kha badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha ṭa/ ru lu rak+kha si/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ste/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+do dang nye ba'i tshan+do/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung spyod dang nye ba'i 'thung spyod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las la skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā hūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/

zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam gyi lhar bsam la/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing / zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod la/ bdud rtsi lce thog tu myangs pas bdag bskyed kyi lha mnyes par bsam pa ste/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'o/ /yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ gang ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la/ ngag tu/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / gsang sngags dang / phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / smon lam gyi dbang gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig se gol gcig gtog yang sngar gyi phyag rgya snying gar bcas la/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ na maḥs mān+ta/ bud+dhā nān/ a bi sa ma ye/ s+pha ra ṇa/ i mam̐/ ga ga na kham̐/ dharmā dhā tu/ ā kā sha sa mān+ta mām̐/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ par+ṣad+da la maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pra ṇi dhā na/ pu ṇ+ya dz+nya na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ban+dha ni/

swas+d+ya/ ba le na tsa swāhā/ phyag rgya bkrol la se gol lan gnyis su gtog go /de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wa ra hi hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te mahā bi d+ye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mas+sarba bhū ta bha ya bā h+ya mahā badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra a sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te bā sh+yaṅka ri ne thra bh+ra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa sho ṣa ṇi/ ro ṣa ṇi/ kro dha ni ka rā li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mas+sa ma tra pa ni/ mā ra ṇi/ su pra bhe da ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥpa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye/ dzam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni/ mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā ra hi/ mahā yo gi ni/ kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas bstod/ de nas dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa 'dis kyang bstod par bya ste/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dang ba'i yid kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi/ /'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo/ /pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma/ /mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chags chen skyes bu 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang / /gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma/ /mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che/ /'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med/ /rgyun mi chad pa'i bde bas ros gang ma/ /mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings/ /mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i/

/rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma/ /mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang / /thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus la/ /yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma/ /mkha' spyod snying rjes yongs gang la phyag 'tshal/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yis/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas/ /rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmigs med snying rjes gzhan gyi dbang gyur nas/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs ma/ /mkha' spyod 'gog pa med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam/ /thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas/ /sku zhi'i dbang phyug zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku/ /mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs/ /dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas/ /srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spangs brjod bral gsung / /mkha' spyod gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam/ /sgrib gnyis sbyong phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas/ /don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs/ /mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas/ /tshe 'di nyid dam bar do la sogs par/ /mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces bstod la/ spros pa la dga' na skabs 'dir zab mo'i yang rtse nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim zab mo'i don rnams bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlob par mdzod cig snyam du/ mdun bskyed kyi mkha' spyod dbang mo dang rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis su med pa la kha zhe med par blo gdeng khel gyi ngang nas thal mo snying gar sbyar la gdangs dang bcas pas/

de ltar bdag gis byang chub bar gyi skyabs/ /bla ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod cing bstod pas rab tu dges mdzad nas/ /bsam don 'di rnams yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi/ /ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa'i las 'bras kyi/ /blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar mdzod/ /skyabs gsum gser gyi cod pan spyi bor bcings/ /byang chub sems gnyis nor bu'i do shal mdzes/ /rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes ltung dri ma bkrus/ /bslu med bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par mdzod/ /yid 'ongs rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma/ /bam̐ yig nang gi rdo rje btsun mo'i mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum/ /rang zhal mthong ba'i rtse dgas rol bar mdzod/ /snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang / /bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /cir snang dag pa'i snang bar 'char bar mdzod/ /de ltar bskyed rim gsal bas pho nya mchog /rigs ldan mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab dus/ /dbu mar rlung zhugs gnyis med ye shes 'bar/ /ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs chen 'byed par mdzod/ /sgyu ma mkhan po 'khrul 'khor gnad la mkhas/ /gdol pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa dang / /shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa ltar/ /kun kyang lus kyi gnad la mkhas par mdzod/ /rtog bcas sems dang zag bcas lus bskyed pa/ /rtsa gnas so sor zhugs pa'i rlung sems rnams/ /dbu mar thim pas mi rtog chos sku dang / /zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob mdzod/ /thun chen drug la thun chung sum cu po/ /re re re re 'phel ba goms pa'i mthus/ /rlung sbyor rgyal po dpal ldan kum+bha kas/ /las rlung ma lus dbu mar zhugs par mdzod/ /lte ba'i pad+mor rlung lnga'i ti la kar/ rtse gcig bsgom pa'i kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis/

/lus sems rtsa la dri bzhon zhugs pa yi/ /bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshims par mdzod/ /lus sems rtsa la rlung rnams rim zhugs pa/ /de tshe tshor bde mi rtog bde ba dang / /mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes legs skyes nas/ /gsal la rdzogs pa'i rtags bcu 'char bar mdzod/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i las kyi gtum mo dang / /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'od kyi gtum mo gnyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lor ro mnyam 'dres pa yis/ /bde drod ye shes lhag par 'bar bar mdzod/ /rdo rje btsun mo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzis/ /'od gzugs gangs ri'i dbang po bzhus pa las/ /a wa dhū tir 'bar 'dzag rnam rol bas/ /bde stong mchog gi dpal la rol bar mdzod/ /ches zab rnal 'byor bcu gcig la 'bad pas/ /nam zhig dus na dga' ma byu ru'i mdog /li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo bas/ /mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du 'khrid par mdzod/ /sin+dhur laṅka li ya'i sdong bur bcas/ /ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun tu/ /myul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can/ /'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par mdzod/ /nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khri shing bcom/ /mchog gi dhū tīr zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su thon/ /khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol bar mdzod/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis/ /stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang / /zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor ma/ /rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar mdzod/ /rtsa rlung thig le e wam̐ dbyings su thim/ /sems nyid bde chen chos sku'i dpal thob nas/ /bgrang yas gzugs sku'i rnam rol dpag med kyis/ /'gro kun mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par mdzod/ /ces brjod pas gsol ba btab la/ de nas bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ tshul bzhin bshams pa'i bum pa/ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i dbus su/ e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon bskor gyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la ḍā ma ru dang / dril bu dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing dam tshig pa bskyed/ de nas ye shes pa bstims shing / go cha 'god pa dang / dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa rnams ni/

phaiṃ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ de nas 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dha3ham̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas go cha dgod pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas phyi nang gis mchod cing bstod pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra ar+gham̐ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin kun la sbyar ba'i/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ nas/ shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dharmā ra ṇi ta/ rol mo dang bcas pa byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur/

/ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod nas lag gnyis pad skor dang bcas pas gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ bum nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha sogs brgya rtsa brgyad dang / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha sogs hūm̐ bzhi ma dang / oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags tshan gnyis po 'di'ang nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas nas gong bzhin mchod cing bstod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid pa dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol la/ dung chos kyi chu bum nang du blug cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi rje btsun ma 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes bum chu nas rdo rje slob dpon la phud phul nas/ sgrub grogs gzhan thams cad la dung chos rnams su cung zad re bkye la/ de nas bdag 'jug bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis su med pa la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur dmigs la/ dbang gi las kyi bya ba rnams ni mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig gis mdzad cing /

tshig rnams ni sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis gsungs par bsam pa'am/ yang na dbang gi tshig dang bya ba thams cad mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang nyid kyis mdzad par bsam pa'ang bshad pas dmigs pa gang bde dang bcas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bum chu nas cung zad 'thung la gdong bkru ba'i tshul bya/ de nas 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra ra khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba/ hūm̐ dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su ma mchis pa la 'jug pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba dang bcas pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas yon phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ lag par me tog cung zad dang bcas pas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro la skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/

de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mdzad par bsam ste/ a kham̐ bī ra hūm̐ gis gdong bcing / yang a kham̐ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog phreng ba blang / mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dpag tu med pa spros te/ bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bid+ye rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod cing bum chu gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod lce la bzhag pas/ nang gi bar chad thams cad zhi bar bsam/ de nas dri ba mdzad cing lan btab par mos la/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /de nas nang gi sems bskyed par bsam la/ rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ de nyid mdun bskyed kyi phyag gi rdo rje rang gi snying gar bzhag nas brtan par byas par mos te/ oṃ sar+b+ba yo ga tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi su ra ti sa ma ya satwam̐ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra yā tha su kham̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas gsang bar gdams par mdzad par bsam la rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng khyod rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod/ rnal 'byor ma'i phyag na gnas pa'i rdo rje la 'jus te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i drung du sleb par mos la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes brjod cing rang gi lag gi rdo rje dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo dud pa re bya'o/ /de yan gyis phyi 'jug song nas/ de nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams gong 'phel du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/

/pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma byin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces pa lan gsum/ de nas khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang sor chud cing bsten par bya'o snyam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la'ang bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas bar/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal dang gsol gdab 'di pa'i lugs kyi bsdus pa'i phyogs la ma byas kyang chog par bshad mod 'on kyang spros pa la dga' bas byed par spro na maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung zhig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo tha mi dad pa la ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi/ sogs 'jug pa dang 'dra bar brjod nas/

de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog pas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams sbyangs/ rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag rus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra wa r+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing / phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang / nang bcud kyi sems can la phog pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la ḍā ma ru dang / dril bu dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs pa dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i lte bar oṃ yig gnyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du bam̐ yig dmar po dang / de'i mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhi smin mtshams kyi thad rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa re re dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dha3ham̐/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar hām̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ mo dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ de nas rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bam̐ yig dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams dang bcas pa shin tu gsal ba'i dmigs pa dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pas/ bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam re rgyangs kyis byon nas/

rang gi zhal nas zhugs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ de ltar rang gi zhal du zhugs pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma des lus kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la gar stabs kyis yang nas yang du 'khyug par mdzad de/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad nas/ mthar lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang gi bam̐ yig la thim pas/ de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la ḍā ma ru dang / dril bu dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs pa dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de ltar rang gi lte ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid la sems gtad pas/ de nyid bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su gang bas gar stabs du ma mdzad cing sngar gyi chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang smin mtshams kyi thad kyi dga' ba 'khyil pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa rnams kyang / g.yon phyogs su myur du 'khor ba gsal bar gyur/ de'i dus su mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs nas rang gi spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sib sib sib thim pas/

rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha sogs oṃ gsum ma'i sngags mang du brjod cing rol chen dang ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra drag tu bya/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dpag tu med pa tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas rang gi spyi bo nas gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod cing rol chen dang / ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra bya/ de ltar byin rlabs zhugs pa de nyid mi 'bral ba'i phyir/ oṃ bam̐/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces brjod pas lus kyi go cha rnams dran par bya/ de nas spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod/ de nas me tog gi phreng ba bla ma rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su 'bul ba'i steng ka tsam bya/ de nas me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ rje btsun mas rang gi spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa swā mi mam̐ sa twa mahā ba la/ zhes gsungs par bsam zhing rang gi spyi bor me tog bzhag de nas dkyil 'khor mthong ba la sgrib byed bsal ba'i mtshon byed du gdong g.yogs bkrol bar mos te/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lam̐ pa hri tram̐/ zhes brjod la/ de nas mdun bskyed kyis gsung bar bsam la de rnams kyi sgo nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad sku dang tsa ka li lta bu ma yin pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin no/

/zhes brjod cing bsam pa de yan gyis 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ de nas dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi/ sogs 'jug gzhan dang 'dra ba brjod la/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyobs pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso/ /de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /lan gsum/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ 'khor yug tu mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phai ཾbadz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dha3ham̐/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de ltar mngon sum lta bur byon pa'i skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/

khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs rnams bskrad par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la me tog 'thor zhing dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /ces brjod/ de nas dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad byon te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsam la/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ ka ka s+ye/ u lu ka s+ye/ shwa na s+ye/ su ka ra s+ye/ ya ma da dhi ye/ ya ma du ti ye/ ya ma dam̐ṣ+ṭi ṇ+ye/ ya ma ma tha ni ye/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha mdun bskyed dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur zhing rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa yin no/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin du gsal ba la mchod pa mdzad par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod la/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung ni/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/
