sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung / mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas thon/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bam̐ yig la thim zhing / de'i mtha' mar g.yon skor du dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan pa byas par gyur/ ces mdun bskyed kyis gsungs par bsam zhing brjod la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de rjes zlos byas par bsam/ de nas me tog 'thor zhing / bcom ldan bdag la stsal legs kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gcig brjod/ rje btsun mas me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu bzhag cing gsungs par bsam la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal legs kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod la me tog spyi bor bzhag de nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun mas sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon nas phyag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas/ rang gi dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su thig le mdzad par bsam zhing / dngos su rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga gsum du reg tsam re byas la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod/ de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum pa'i dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lam bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de yan gyis bum dbang bzlas lung dang bcas pa song nas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems thig le dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba thod pa'i nang du lhung ba/

bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rang gi lce thog tu bzhag ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha sogs oṃ gsum ma'i sngags tshar gcig dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing myangs pas/ rang gi lus kyi rtsa nang gi byang sems dam tshig pa'i tshul dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag cing / gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam la/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsang ba'i dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ lam rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma ut+pa la gzhon nu kha 'byed pa'i man ngag bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru kar gyur pa dang / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mkha' nang du byin par gyur/ ces brjod cing mdun bskyed kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dga' 'khyil/ sngags 'phreng / bam̐ yig dang bcas pa nas bla ma rje btsun ma'i phyag g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs nas/ rang gi gsang gnas/ lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ skra mtshams rnams su mas yar reg ste thig le mdzad par bsam la/ dngos su rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis gsang gnas/ lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ skra mtshams rnams su mas yar reg pa'i tshul bya zhing / oṃ oṃ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha sogs oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod cing / lag pa gnyis pad skor 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3ham̐/

zhes brjod cing sems kyi dmigs pa rang gi mkha' nang gi byang chub kyi sems de nyid 'og rlung skyod pa'i stobs kyis yar drangs/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad byang sems kyis khrig mer gang bas dga' ba'i ye shes/ yar drangs snying ga'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas mchog dga'i ye shes/ yar drangs mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas dga' bral gyi ye shes/ yar drangs spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ de'i tshe lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ de thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ des khyab tshad la bde bas khyab/ bde ba la stong pas khyab pa'i mdor na bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lam phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de nas dbang bzhi pa ni mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rje btsun mas gsungs par bsam la/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos/ /nam mkha' lta bu dri ma med/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rjes yis/ /stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom/ /zhes brjod/ de'i don ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs bden pa'i dngos po cung zad tsam yang ye gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bya ba de ni yod med rtag chad srid zhi'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ de'i ngo bo la/ gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa'i dri mas gdod ma nas gos ma myong bas dri ma med pa/ de lta bu'i yul stong pa nyid de/ yul can gnyis snang thams cad nub pa'i gnyis med ye shes kyi rdo rje yis stong pa nyid du bsgom zhes pa zung 'jug gi ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag

de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rje btsun mas gsungs par bsam nas brjod la/ de ltar thob pa gong 'phel du byas pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum dang / dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i gtang rag tu dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa zhes sogs maṇ+ḍal bdun ma spyi dang 'dra ba las/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi/ zhes sogs spyi dang 'dra ba brjod la/ de nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa yang yon du 'bul ba la/ cha shas kyis longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum brjod/ de nas skabs 'dir spros pa la dga' bas lam srol zab mo 'di nyid kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa dang / bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas gsol 'debs bya bar 'dod na/ spyir 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang / rgyud/ man ngag gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / bye brag nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol 'debs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo nyid dang /

brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi rang babs la nges shes dung pa dang bcas pas/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gi rjes su/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /gang gis skye dang 'jig pa dag /ring du yongs su spangs gyur cing / /sems can kun la thams cad du/ /phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi don 'dzin cing / /sems can kun la kun stsol ba'i/ /kun mchog rdo rje 'chang dbang la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la mngon sum du/ /khyod kyis chos rnams thugs tshud de/ /mda' 'dzin spyod pa mdzad pa la/ /rtag tu༞ thub pas thub par lung bstan cing / /chos rnams don ston klu sgrub mchog /bde ba can du gshegs pa la/ /rtag tu༞ /nyid kyi de nyid mchog brnyes nas/ /dman mos sems can don gyi phyir/ /rngon pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa la/ rtag tu༞ yi ge'i sbyor ba spangs nas su/ /brtson pas nya rgyu gsol mdzad de/ /brtse bas gzhan don mdzad pa la/ /rtag tu༞ rgyal po'i bya ba rab spangs nas/ /sprul 'tshong rjes su sgrub mdzad de/ /kañtsa'i grong du grub pa la/ rtag tu༞ /ye shes mkha' 'gros rjes gnang zhing / /gzhan don spyod pa mngon sum mdzad/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa la/ /rtag tu༞ dam pa'i de nyid don rtogs te/ /brtse bas rus sbal zhabs ldan pa/ /sems can smin par mdzad pa la/ /rtag tu༞ khyod ni brtson pas grub brnyes te/ /'bar bas 'bar ba'i spyod 'dzin cing / /kun la phan par mdzad pa la/ /rtag tu༞ nus pa la ni mnga' brnyes shing / /spyod pa kun gyi rmad byung ba/ /'jig rten 'dren par mdzad pa la/ /rtag tu༞ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gu h+ya pa/ /brtse bas log 'dren rnal 'byor ma/

/btul nas 'gro ba skyong ba la/ /rtag tu༞ mi mthun phyogs rnams rab spangs te/ /dkar po rnam par 'phel mdzad pas/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs pad la/ /rtag tu༞ grub nas grub pa'i lam ston cing / /grol nas rnam par phan mdzad pa/ /bar ma'i slob dpon dam pa la/ /rtag tu༞ til brdungs pas ni rab grub pa/ /skal ldan gzhan la brtse ba can/ /mu stegs rnam par sun 'byin la/ /rtag tu༞ bram ze las ni rab byung zhing / /gnas lnga la ni rab sbyangs shing / /dka' bas dam pa bsten pa la/ /rtag tu༞ shes bya la ni rab sbyangs shing / /nus pa kun la thogs med ldan/ /pha na phem gur grags pa la/ /rtag tu༞ skad gnyis smra ba'i mchog gyur cing / /shes rab ldan pas phan mdzad pa/ /brtsegs pa'i mtha' dang ldan pa la/ /rtag tu༞ brtson pas dka' ba cher mdzad de/ /rgyud kun 'dzin mdzad skad gnyis smra/ /rje btsun blo gros grags pa la/ /rtag tu༞ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum du/ /khyod la byin gyis brlabs pa yis/ /shes bya kun la thogs med ldan/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi bdag por gyur/ /kun dga' snying por grags pa yi/ /dpal ldan sa skyar bzhugs gyur cing / /bde ba can du gshegs pa la/ /rtag tu༞ gang gi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /gnas lnga la ni rab mkhas shing / /bsod nams ye shes rtser gyur pa/ /nyid kyi gzhan don rdzogs mdzad nas/ /'jig rten rnams ni gzhug pa'i phyir/ /bde ba can du mngon sum gshegs/ /rtag tu༞ khyod kyi thugs ni 'jam dbyangs ltar/ /shes bya kun la rab mkhas shing / /'jig rten kun la rtsa lag ltar/ /dgongs pas khyod kyi grags pa yi/ /rgyal mtshan dri ma med pa thob/ /ngo mtshar du ma'i spyod pa 'dzin/ /kun nas yon tan ldan khyod la/ /rtag tu༞ brtse bas sems can thams cad la/ /dpal 'byor chen po'i 'od zer gyis/ /rtag par skyong bar mdzad khyod la/ /rtag tu༞ 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig gi

/chos gos 'dzin par legs sprul pa'i/ /sa skya paṇa chen zhabs pad la/ /rtag tu༞ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpal 'byor dang / /mkhas shing grub pa'i blo gros can/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa la/ /rtag tu༞ sbyangs pa'i yon tan lhur mdzad de/ /rim pa gnyis la thugs brten pa/ /zhang ston dkon mchog dpal ba la/ /rtag tu༞ bla ma'i zhabs tog dka' ba spyad/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /grub chen bsod nams dpal ba la/ /rtag tu༞ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ste/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khrir 'khod pa'i/ /'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ /rtag tu༞ snyan rgyud gdams pa'i dpal ldan zhing / /rnam dag tshul khrims gos bzang can/ /rgyal sras rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /rtag tu༞ gnyis med ye shes legs gzigs shing / /gzhan phan lhag bsam cher bskyed pa'i/ /chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan la/ /rtag tu༞ e wam̐ rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu/ /zung 'jug chos kyi sku brnyes pa/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /rtag tu༞ gcig tu sgrub la brtson mdzad cing / /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa'i/ /mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa la/ /rtag tu༞ bsod nams gangs ri'i spor gnas shing / /lung dang rigs pa'i mche sder can/ /kun mkhyen smra ba'i seṅge la/ /rtag tu༞ rig pa'i gnas kun rab sbyangs te/ /grub pa'i sa brnyes chos kyi rje/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la/ /rtag tu༞ dkon mchog dges pa'i mthu ldan zhing / /mkha' ltar yangs pa'i blo gros can/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po la/ /rtag tu༞ dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing / /lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /nges don gdams pa 'phel mdzad la/ /rtag tu༞ mkhyen pas shes bya'i de nyid gzigs/ /brtse dang nus pa rmad byung ba/ /rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas la/ /rtag tu༞ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /dam chos rin chen kun gyi gter/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan la/

/rtag tu༞ rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs shing / /grub pa'i byin rlabs bka' bab pa/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la/ /rtag tu༞ snyigs dus dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog gyur pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po la/ /rtag tu༞ byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba mtsho/ /snyigs dus slar yang mi yi zol/ /sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la/ /rtag tu༞ rje btsun sems dpa' chen po nyid/ /'khor lo sdom par mngon sum du/ /legs gzigs sangs rgyas dpal bzang la/ /rtag tu༞ dpal ldan bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ /rjes bzung chos kyi rgyal po gang / /lung rtogs yon tan mdzod 'dzin la/ /rtag tu༞ gang gi gsung gi bdud rtsi las/ /legs 'khrungs bzang po'i chu skyes mchog /skal ldan bung ba'i dpal gyur la/ /rtag tu༞ mkhyen rab nam mkha' ltar yangs pas/ /shes bya kun la dbang phyug pa'i/ /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa la/ /rtag tu༞ dpal ldan 'khor lo bde mchog dang / /dbyer med chos kyi 'byung gnas che/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dbang phyug la/ /rtag tu༞ sbyin bya bzhi dang blang bya gnyis/ /drod dang spyod pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /khyab bdag sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ /rtag tu༞ rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma yis/ /rjes bzung sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la/ /rtag tu༞ dngos kun khyab bdag bde ba'i mchog /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i he ru ka /shes rab sgyu ma'i btsun mo dang / /rol mdzad bde ba chen por 'dud/ /zung 'jug de nyid ma thob bar/ /rje btsun bla mas rjes bzung ste/ /mngal sgong rdzus skyes dkyil 'khor du/ /sbyin bya dbang bzhis smin par shog /zab mo'i lam gyi rtsa ba mchog /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /ma nyams tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog /ma dag skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba'i/ /gsal dag bskyed rim legs bsgom te/ /snang ba lha ru 'char ba dang / /bzhi sogs 'phrin las dbang bsgyur shog

/rgyud rim gnas lugs shes byas nas/ /sngags rim gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /ye shes dga' bzhi'i rim pa bskyed/ /gsang ba'i rim pa 'grub par shog /de lta'i rim gnyis la brtson pas/ /drod thob spyod pas mtshams sbyar te/ /rab dga' la sogs sa bsgrod nas/ /rtse gcig phyag chen 'grub par shog /khyad par skye ba 'di nyid la/ /mtshan 'dzin kun rtog rab spangs nas/ /ḍeṃ gi dha ri ka pa bzhin/ /gsang chen spyod pa mthar phyin shog /'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /nam yang mi 'bral gnas gsum gyi/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan cig gnas/ /rig 'dzin dbang po nyid gyur cig /bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i nus mthu yis/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa thob shog /ces pa 'di'i gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod nas 'byung ba yin la/ gang gi skye dang 'jig pa dag /ces sogs nas/ rtag tu skyong bar mdzad khyod la/ /zhes pa'i bar rnams chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad cing / de'i rjes su/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis ngur smrig gi /zhes sogs nas/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi kha skong rnams/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du/ bde mchog gi rgyud bshad rgyas par gnang ba'i tshe mdzad pa yin la/ dngos kun khyab bdag bde ba'i mchog /ces sogs lam rim gyi smon lam 'di rnams/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pas/ bde mchog srin po rir/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa zhig gi tshe mdzad par bshad pas/ rgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di rnams/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa'i skyes chen dam pa 'ba' zhig gi gsung yin pas shin tu byin rlabs che'o/ /'di'i sngags 'chang chen po'i gsol 'debs 'di/

bdag gi bla ma dbang po'i mtshan can gyis mdzad par snang la/ gzhan gsol 'debs kyi kha skong rnams ni kho bos byas so/ /de ltar 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang rgyud man ngag gi bla ma brgyud pa spyi la gsol ba btab nas/ bye brag nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /grub chen nā ro pa dang pham mthing pa/ /shes rab brtsegs dang mal lo sa skya pa/ /rje btsun sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che/ /dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems dpa' che/ /bsod nams seng ge bud+dha rat+na'i zhabs/ /sa skya lo tsā sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /'jam dbyangs sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas dpal bzang dpal ldan rgyal po dang / /bzang po dpal ba paṇa chen nam dbang mtshan/ /rje btsun chos dbang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskyed rim zab mo mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dang / /rdzogs rim dbu ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /bde chen lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang / /mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa ste/ de ltar brgyud 'debs rgyas bsdus gnyis car ram bsdus pa rkyang pa la sogs pa gang 'os skabs dang sbyar nas byas pa'i rjes su/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs pa rnams thun mong du byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor ma rnams la gtor la/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ go las ba glang gi sha shar du ku las khyi'i sha byang du da las glang po che'i sha nub tu ha las rta'i sha lhor na las mi'i sha de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bh+rum̐ me long lta bu'i༞ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i༞ nub tu dz+ṝṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ lhor am̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar zhing rdzas rnams zhu zhing skol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par byung nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba gtor ma la thim/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ zhes pas sngags lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas yi dam kyai rdo rje dang /

bde mchog 'khor lo gnyis la gtor chog bzhin phul nas/ mkha' spyod ma'i gtor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ lan gsum/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin rlabs dran par byas la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing / phaiṃ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ma la gnyis su med par thim zhing / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mtha' skor du bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ lha de thams cad kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / pad skor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha sogs oṃ gsum ma'i sngags la/ oṃ a ka ro mu kham̐ sar+b+ba dharmā ṇam̐ a d+yam̐ nud pan na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra ar+gham̐ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin kun la sbyar ba'i/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ nas/ shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dharmā ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul/ ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wā ra hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā ra hi mahā yo gi ni/ kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa'i bar rkang pa brgyad kyis bstod nas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa des ni lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pas gsol ba btab la/ de nas gur gyi mgon po lcam dral zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug gdong bzhi pa/

dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ 'phrin las rab tu myur ba'i las mkhan pu ṭa lcam sring / bstan skyong ma mo kun gyi gtso mo dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod 'phreng can/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag rnams la/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gtor chog nang bzhin phul la/ de nas bzlas pa/ bshags pa/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ bskang ba/ bstod pa/ gtor 'bul sogs/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag len bzhin rgyas bsdus long skabs dang sbyar nas byas la/ slob ma la sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs byed dgos yod na skabs 'dir bya'o/ /'di'i rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa'i gang zag ni/ rab bde mchog lū nag gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/ 'bring 'khor lo bde mchog gang rung / mtha' na'ang kyai rdor man ngag lugs lta bu gnyis med rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung du dbang thob cing / 'di'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par mnos nas/ bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang / rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i khrid sogs dang / de dag gi rgyab rten rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig rnams las 'byung ba ltar gyi nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa rnams kyi bshad pa dang lung la sogs pa mtha' chod par thob nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yum rkyang ngam/ yab yum gnyis med kyi sgo nas sar+b+ba bud+dha la bzhi 'bum la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa las su rung ba zhig byung na mchog tu gyur par gsungs la/ gal te nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid sogs chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa ma thob cing / rnal 'byor ma yum rkyang ngam/ bde mchog yab yum gnyis med kyi sgo nas sarba bud+dha la bzhi 'bum sogs kyi bsnyen pa ma grub kyang / gong du bshad pa ltar gyi dbang dang byin rlabs tshul bzhin du thob cing /

kyai rdo rje lta bu'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa zhig ni/ lugs 'di'i rdo rje slob dpon bya ba la cis kyang dgos pa yin te/ deng sang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i grub mtha'i srol 'dzin gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal che ba'i phyag len de kho na ltar mdzad pa dang / sngon gyi bla ma gong ma 'khrul pa zad pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun dag las kyang de dang 'dra bar byung bas rang re rjes 'jug rnams thugs rtog zhib len mdzad pa gal che'o/ /de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ oṃ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ ghan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+da ā hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra ar+gham̐ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin kun la sbyar ba'i/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ nas/ shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dharmā rā ṇ-i rol mo dang bcas pa byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri bā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun du rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid pa dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

zhes pas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing / gtor mgron sogs kyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs spyi dang 'dra ba byas la/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel te byed na/ nub dang po rnams la/ bye brag tu yang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams ji srid gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas gtor mgron rten med pa rnams la gshegs gsol byas la go cha dgod pa/ tsham rngam sngags kyi bsrung ba/ dga' ba gsum dran pa/ smon lam bkra shis sogs byed/ sgrub mchod grol ba'i mjug chog gi tshe/ bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa'ang sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bzhag la/ gong du bshad pa ltar rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs kyi rjes su/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams dang / mdun bskyed kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs dang / badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ zhes sogs nas/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyi go cha dgod/ sum+bha ni tshar gnyis brjod cing sdigs mdzub phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor bstan la tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrungs/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'am rang bzhin/

oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs tshar gcig brjod la/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/ hūm̐/ sems kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes pas dga' ba gsum dran par byas nas/ de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis/ /me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang / /rol mo sgra snyan glu dbyangs sogs mchod cing / /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /de gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa des ni lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces sogs kyi smon lam rgya cher btab la/ de nas bkra shis bya ba ni/ rje btsun byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bkra shis dge legs kyi dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di nyid bya ste/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal chen nā ro sogs/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos kun spro dang bsdud mdzad ma/ /mkha' spyod chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rab mdzes brjid pa'i sku/ /drug cu'i dbyangs ldan theg mchog sgrog pa'i gsung / /ye shes lnga ldan bde gsal mi rtog thugs/ /lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yis/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i don/

/sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin bsgrub mdzad ma/ /zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rje btsun ma/ /'dzum khro'i nyams ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis/ /gri thod legs 'dzin zhabs zung brkyangs bskums tshul/ /mngal skyes mkha' spyod mchog gi bkra shis shog /gang gi rnam sprul grangs med bye ba phrag /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis tshogs rnams kyis/ /sgrub pa po yi bar chad kun sel zhing / /'dod don dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / gzhan yang chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing sgrub khang gi phyogs kun tu me tog gi char dbab par bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zab mo'i lam gyi dbang dang byin rlabs/ gdams pa'i tshogs rnams thob nas/ gang zag dbang po rab kyis bzlas sgom kho na chag med du nyams su blang zhing / 'di rang gi bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byas/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang / mar ngo'i nyer lnga ste/ tshes bcu gnyis kyi mchod pa la brtson par byas pa tsam gyis/ re zhig na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal gyi bud med kyi rnam pas 'byon zhing / de ltar byon pa de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa la yin par ngo shes/ des rnal 'byor pa'i lag pa'i 'khrig ma nas bzung ste/ lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'khyer bar bshad cing / gang zag dbang po 'bring gis de ltar nyams su blangs kyang rtags sogs ci yang ma byung na/ 'di rang gi bsnyen pa yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bum tshar gnyis tsam bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa dang / lam̐ ka ling ka'i shing la brten nas sin+dhū ra bsgrub pa'i sgrub pa byas/ de rjes/ sin+dhu ra des rang gi dpral bar dga' ba 'khyil pa bri zhing / 'phongs ra lta bu bud med mang du 'tshogs pa'i sar phyin nas/ rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal brtan pos bltas pa'i tshe/

bud med gang gi dpral bar me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin dga' 'khyil 'phos na/ de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid yin pas/ g.yon nas bskor ba sogs gsol ba btab pas/ des rang gi 'khrig ma nas bzung ste mkha' spyod du 'khyer bar gsungs pa ni/ 'bring bsnyen sgrub las gsum la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa zhes bya ba yin la/ gang zag dbang po tha mas/ de lta bu bya ba ma grub pa'am/ grub kyang ji lta ba bzhin ma byung na/ da dung sgyid lug mi bya bar bzlas sgom nan tan du nyams su blangs pas/ nam zhig 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku las/ bar dor langs pa na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas sgom byed pa'i snang ba 'byung zhing / de la brten nas dus de nyid du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pas sgrub pa po de seng ge'i khri la bzhag 'ja'i gur phub/ me tog gi char 'bebs bzhin pas mkha' spyod du 'khyer ba ni nges pa yin par gsungs la/ de lta bu'i mkha' spyod la yang / mkha' spyod chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi sa yin zhing / mkha' spyod chung ngu ni 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad nam mkha' las 'byung ba/ tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar du thub cing / rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro nus pas sprul sku las dngos su chos nod cing / sprul sku'i zhing khams rnams su thogs med du bgrod nus pa/ tshe de la sangs rgya nges pa zhig yin par bshad do/ /de ltar mchog tu zab cing shin du 'grub thag nye ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam 'di nyid la brten nas rgya bod kyi skyes chen grangs med pa zhig mkha' spyod du byon pa'i lo rgyus 'byung yang / 'dir skal bzang rnams spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun rnam thar sogs nas 'byung ba ltar rags rim zhig khungs bstan tsam brjod na/

rgya gar 'phags yul du grub chen dril bu pa/ dpal nā ro pa chen po/ a bha ya ka ra sogs 'di'i lam la brten nas grub thob bya khyu 'phur ba ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / bod gangs chen 'dir yang / pu hrang lo tsā bas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod 'grub tshul/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i slob ma bsgom pa mo'i lo rgyus dang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la mkha' spyod nas spyan 'dren byung tshul/ nam za brag phug pa'i nye gnas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon tshul/ yang nam za brag phug pa'i slob ma bdun lus ma spangs par song tshul/ grub chen bud+dha ba'i slob ma zhig dgon pa'i dge slong de ba ma ti/ nyer lnga la mkha' spyod mas spyan drangs tshul/ bla ma dam pa mkha' spyod mas rjes su bzung tshul/ sngags 'chang gzungs pa la mkha' spyod mas byu ru dmar po'i skas dngos su btsugs tshul/ bzang po rgyal mtshan gyi gdung la rnal 'byor ma rang byon 'khrungs tshul/ bla chen chos dpal bas sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa byas pas khong gshegs dus rnal 'byor ma'i sku rang byon 'phel tshul/ khams pa bsod nams bzang po rnal 'byor mas mkha' spyod la dngos su khyer tshul/ shar chen ye rgyal la rnal 'byor mas/ 'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su khyer/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan byung ba dang / rdo rje 'chang gi slob ma tsha ba rong pa shākya rgyal mtshan 'phan yul gyi ri las lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs tshul/ yang tsha ba rong pa bsod nams bzang po/ tsha rong gi ri las 'chi khar mkha' spyod du gshegs tshul/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i slob ma gsum mkha' spyod du dngos su gshegs pa'i lo rgyus dang / paṇa chen gung ru la rnal 'byor mas dngos su rjes su bzung tshul/ chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po la rje btsun mas rak+ta dbu zhwa'i nang du stsal tshul/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang la nang mchod kyi steng du rnal 'byor ma tshon gang pa dngos su byon nas zhal bstan tshul/

srad pa kun blo la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mi'i bu mo dngos kyi rnam par bstan tshul dang / khong byang chen du gshegs pa rnal 'byor mas bsu ba'i 'od zer dge ldan pas mthong bas brang brdungs tshul/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas 'pho ba legs par thebs tshul/ pu hrang rnal 'byor pa la rnal 'byor ma la brten nas bar chad bsal tshul dang gdung la rnal 'byor ma byon tshul/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa mnal lam du rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung tshul/ kun mkhyen rin po che dang / sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyang rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba la brten nas bde ba can du gshegs tshul/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal pa'i bud med kyi tshul sogs rnam sprul du mas mngon sum du zhal yang yang bstan tshul/ bdag gi bla ma rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can de nyid la yang / rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma shar dros la bsam gtan phu'i gzim phug tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi bsu ba dngos su byon nas de dag dang gsung gleng mdzad pa rje dbon gyis gnam sgo'i steng gi gzim phug gi mdo nas thos tshul/ de nas nyer gcig nam langs la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mda' kha ma'i rnal 'byor gsal 'debs par mdzad de/ phaṭ che ba gnyis dang / hika chung ngu zhig gsung ba'i mod la/ de ma thag dbu las chu skol ba lta bu'i rlangs pa chen po skya bun pa dang bcas skad cig nyid la dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga zangs thal du gyur pa nas dbu ma lta bu'i sbom phra smyug ma 'bring po tsam gyi rtsa sbubs stong zhig rgyang gis 'thon pa las byang sems nyi le ba dang bcas thogs pa med par mkha' spyod chen po 'og min du gshegs pa'i tshul/ snar thang sde pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pas dge ldan pa'i sku mang po bshigs shing sdig bsags kyang / gshegs dus rnal 'byor ma la brten nas dbu gtsug 'phar tshul/

bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje'i gdung la oṃ gsum ma byon tshul/ sgrub chen pa seng ge grags gshegs dus sin+dhu ra'i char babs tshul/ de la sogs te rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod 'di la brten nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma thob pa'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa zhig 'byung bas skal bzang rnams 'di'i bzlas sgom 'chag med du bgyid cing bsnyen sgrub sogs la 'bad pa dang / tshes bcu'i mchod pa bgyid pa'ang skal ba bzang por shes par byas nas yid dga' yal le shes pa spro sing nge ba'i ngang nas/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rnam rtog rgyang ring du spangs te tshig don la sems rtse gcig tu bsgril te nyams su len pa zhu/ de dag gis ni rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa 'gro kun mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba legs par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos kyi bcud/ /dpal mo mkha' spyod dga' ma'i nye lam mchog /dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun gser chos gang / /dpal mchog he ru ka dpal mus pa rje'i/ 1 /gsung gi bcud 'di 'di phyir phan 'dod rnams/ /brtson pas legs sgrubs bsgrubs na 'khor ba las/ /nges par myur grol grol ba mchog thob 'gyur/ /de phyir skal bzang bzang po'i las 'phro can/ 2 /snying dbus bzhugs pa'i mkha' spyod dbang mo de/ /snying nas bsgrub par 'dod pa'i slob bu rnams/ /snying gi gdams pa mkha' spyod myur lam 'di/ /snying ltar gces par zungs la don gnyis sgrubs/ 3 /rab 'byams rgyud sde'i snying po gsang ba'i gtam/ /rab mang mkhas grub bye ba gshegs pa'i lam/ /rab mchog rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab las/ /rab gus blo yis legs par btus te sbyar/ 4 /nam yang tshe 'di'i las la zin med cing /

/nam 'chi cha med nges par 'chi ba'i tshul/ /nam gyi srod dang tho rangs legs bsams na/ /nam yang chos med dal bar 'dug phod dam/ 5 /bdag 'dra dam pa'i rigs su skyes mod kyang / /bdag tu 'dzin pa chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis/ /bdag yid dam du bcings pa 'di bsam na/ /bdag ni phyi ma gar skye ngan song las ma 'das pas a tsa ma/ 6 /'on kyang rdo rje 'chang dngos rje dang mjal/ /mjal bar ma zad gdams pa rgya mtsho thos/ /thos tsam min par thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /'dres pas 'di phyi'i don kun lhun gyis grub/ 7 /des na bdag dang bdag gi gdul bya kun/ /kun mkhyen ma thob bar du yongs 'dzin rje/ /rje btsun khyod las lhag pa'i skyabs gzhan med/ /med phyir 'bral med thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol/ 8 /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /'dir ni tshe ring don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /'di nas mkha' 'gros mngon sum mdun bsus nas/ /'di phyir 'bral med don kun 'grub gyur cig 9 /ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa 'gro kun mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen po dpal sa skya pa chen po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rje btsun mus pa chen po 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can/ rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa/ grub pa mchog gi ded dpon chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan la sogs te/ yongs 'dzin dam pa du ma las gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bka' drin mnos shing / khyad par rje btsun mus pa chen po las/ dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi nying khu 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i dbang byin rlabs/

bskyed rdzogs kyi zab khrid rgyud dang rgya bod kyi tshad ldan gyi gzhung du ma'i bshad lung sogs mdor na rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin mnos pa'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rang gzhan thams cad mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang bsgrub pa'i slad du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgya gzhung gi dgongs 'grel tshad mar gyur pa/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i yig cha tshad ldan du ma zhig gi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu dpal sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang / kun mkhyen rin po che/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / paṇa chen gung ru/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ rje tshar chen yab sras/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil chog byin rlabs kyi yi ge sogs gsung rab de dag gi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa yin pas/ kho bo'i rang bzo cung zad kyang med do/ /bsdus nas/ rgya gar lugs la k+ṣa ya zhes pa zad pa dang / rgya nag lugs la me pho stag gi lo/ phāl ghu naḥzhes pa'i dus kyi dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas kyi bzhi thog bla brang gi sa gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi drung ga la ba der legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis sor mo'i 'du byed las legs par bskrun pa'o/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde dpag tu med pa 'byung zhing /

bdag cag dpon slob thams cad tshe 'di'am/ 'chi kha'am/ bar dor mkha' spyod dbang mos rjes su bzung nas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'dren nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig /smras pa/ kho bos byas pa'i sgrub dkyil 'di nyid ni/ /tshad ldan gong ma'i gsung rab mang po las/ /btus phyir phyogs re mthong ba rgyu mtshan du/ /byas nas lugs 'dir som nyi ma byed cig /ces kyang gdams pa ste rgyu mtshan spros pas chog go/ //sarba maṅga laṃ/ ka l+ya ṇa bar+dhan+tu/ gcig zhus dag/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 48 a myes zhabs/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag 'jug dbang blang ba'i tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 47
